create_selection_instance: create a Selection instance with a HabitatSim simulator and GuiInput for object selection
update_selection: update the Selection object to raycast and select the object under the cursor
deselect_object: deselect the currently selected object and clear selection state including point and normal
configure_selection_trigger: configure Selection with hover_fn, left_click_fn, or right_click_fn to trigger selection
filter_selectable_objects: filter selectable objects using a custom object_id_discriminator callable passed to Selection
